$comment: Hand-editable source of truth for omarchy.nixfred.com. scripts/build.ts merges this with live GitHub stars and the official marketplace registry.json to produce site/data.json. Never edit site/data.json by hand.

families.name: The Pulse Suite
families.blurb: One visual language for what the machine is doing to itself. Pulse carries CPU, memory, storage and network in one icon; sound and battery keep their own.

families.name: The Mac Bridge
families.blurb: Your phone and your Mac, in the Linux bar. The Mac is the gateway, this machine is the client, nothing is proxied through a stranger.

families.name: Workspace Control
families.blurb: Hyprland workspaces that name themselves, pack themselves, and remember what belonged on them.

families.name: The AI Desk
families.blurb: What the agents on this machine are actually doing, and what they are costing.

families.name: Infrastructure
families.blurb: The boring, load-bearing ones. Backups, exposed ports, latency, fleet health.

families.name: Media and Output
families.blurb: Sound and pixels leaving this machine for somewhere else in the house.

families.name: System and Desk
families.blurb: Everyday surfaces. Clipboard, clock, bluetooth, sleep, the car.

plugins.name: OmaGuard
plugins.tagline: Knows what your desktop looked like when it was right.
plugins.description: A shield in the bar and your saved bar layouts in one click. Load a layout, and OmaGuard tells you when the bar has unsaved changes to it (Save, Undo, Save as new). The shield only counts problems the live desktop confirms, each with how to fix it.

plugins.name: RAM Speed Test
plugins.tagline: Memory read and write, on the speed test dials.
plugins.description: Sustained multi-core memory copy and triad throughput, with thread scaling, pressure checks and JSON reports.

plugins.name: Pulse
plugins.tagline: One icon showing whatever is holding the machine back.
plugins.description: CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU monitoring in one bar icon, with a shared severity model and a full dashboard for each domain. Replaces the separate CPU, RAM, Disk and Net Pulse widgets.
plugins.supersedes: CPU Pulse, RAM Pulse, Disk Pulse, Net Pulse

plugins.name: Trackpad Pulse
plugins.tagline: Your trackpad, in motion.
plugins.description: Your trackpad as a live instrument: fingers, taps, gestures, speed and seven days of history, on top of Trackpad Plus's per-device controls and pointer-feel curve.

plugins.name: Audio Pulse
plugins.tagline: A living audio chip.
plugins.description: A living audio chip: volume, mute, output picker and per-app mixer, drawn as a sibling of RAM Pulse, CPU Pulse and Net Pulse.

plugins.name: Power Pulse
plugins.tagline: Battery as a glowing flux cell whose colour is its charge.
plugins.description: Battery as a glowing flux cell whose colour is its charge: blue when full, yellow in the middle, red when low. A stream of glowing atoms rides in while charging, out on battery, with glints popping around them. Charge-limit slider, hour-long up/down power trace, live wattage, power profiles.

plugins.name: Blip
plugins.tagline: iMessage in the Omarchy bar.
plugins.description: Read and send iMessage from the Omarchy bar through a Mac you own over SSH. Includes thread history, compose, groups and an unread badge, with allowlisted desktop notifications.

plugins.name: Shipyard
plugins.tagline: What shipped today.
plugins.description: Local Git activity in the bar: commits, streaks, a 16-week heatmap, time-of-day histogram and repository feed. Read-only; no network.

plugins.name: Tomato
plugins.tagline: A pomodoro ring on the bar.
plugins.description: Pomodoro timer with presets, daily totals, seven-day history and streaks. Timestamp-based state survives a shell restart.

plugins.name: Pingboard
plugins.tagline: Is it me, the ISP, or DNS?
plugins.description: Live latency, jitter and loss to your gateway, the internet, DNS and your tailnet hosts, with a verdict that says where the problem is: LAN, ISP, DNS or tailnet.

plugins.name: Daylight
plugins.tagline: Sun and moon, computed locally.
plugins.description: Sun and moon ephemeris computed locally. See sunrise, sunset, golden and blue hours, twilight, moon phase and the next full and new moons.

plugins.name: Hourglass
plugins.tagline: Where the day went.
plugins.description: Local screen-time tracking from Hyprland window classes: daily focus ribbon, app ring, seven-day history, streaks and stretch nudges. Window titles are never recorded.

plugins.name: Sentinel
plugins.tagline: Systemd and journal watchdog.
plugins.description: Watch failed systemd units, journal error bursts, upcoming timers and noisy services. Restart and Logs controls act only when selected.

plugins.name: Dockyard
plugins.tagline: Docker, at a glance.
plugins.description: Docker container status, CPU, memory, ports, uptime and image storage in a native panel. Start, stop, restart and read logs through explicit controls.

plugins.name: Plonk
plugins.tagline: Workspaces close their own gaps.
plugins.description: Packs numeric Hyprland workspaces into 1…N as gaps appear, preserving order, tiling, monitor placement, and focus.

plugins.name: Rift
plugins.tagline: Hyprland tiles, Rift remembers.
plugins.description: Save the applications on a workspace as a named Rift and reopen them on demand or at login — straight from the Omarchy bar. No geometry saved: Hyprland keeps tiling.

plugins.name: Workspace Names
plugins.tagline: Numbers stay numbers. Now they have a name too.
plugins.description: Give numbered Hyprland workspaces a title without changing their numbers. Automatic app-based names, inline rename and a live map of occupancy and app identities.

plugins.name: MenuBar Overload
plugins.tagline: Add as many plugins as you like.
plugins.description: The Omarchy bar with a carousel on each side. Add as many plugins as you like; roll through the ones that do not fit with the mouse wheel or a trackpad swipe, and each one pops out as it arrives.

plugins.name: Infomarchy
plugins.tagline: Your wallpaper becomes a live information desk.
plugins.description: A live, clickable wallpaper desk for AI sessions, proactive next-action alerts, repository health, Ollama controls, activity, usage limits, and machine telemetry. Theme-driven. SUPER+D overlay. Optional Web Mode.

plugins.name: Burn Bar
plugins.tagline: A thermal heat map of what the AIs are costing you.
plugins.description: Track Claude, Codex, Grok, Kimi and local Ollama usage in a thermal heat map, with subscription pacing, quota gauges and the share of tokens handled locally.

plugins.name: PR Hunter
plugins.tagline: Open pull requests, and the workspace to deal with them.
plugins.description: GitHub PRs and issues for Herdr and saved projects. Open the right workspace or terminal and hand work to an existing agent.

plugins.name: Tailscale Host Monitor
plugins.tagline: Your whole tailnet, from the bar.
plugins.description: Select nodes from your Tailscale network, track every device type, and collect deep Linux metrics over read-only SSH.

plugins.name: Backup Sizzle
plugins.tagline: Restic, with a countdown ring and an outcome calendar.
plugins.description: Restic backup with live B2 throughput, countdown ring, outcome calendar, anomaly notes, snapshot browser and run history.

plugins.name: Internet Latency
plugins.tagline: Live color-coded latency, with the loss and jitter behind it.
plugins.description: Live color-coded internet latency with target selection, packet loss, jitter, and history.

plugins.name: LANarchy
plugins.tagline: Your homelab, drawn as it actually is.
plugins.description: Homelab topology map and health in the Omarchy bar — machines, services, UniFi and measured traffic. Fork of Donnie Fiander's Lanarchy.

plugins.name: Beatdeck
plugins.tagline: A live spectrum that opens a media cockpit.
plugins.description: Beatbar's live spectrum as the trigger for the Living Media Cockpit — click for now playing, right click for the visuals
plugins.credit: Built on Beatbar, by ryrobes and contributors.

plugins.name: Sonomarchy
plugins.tagline: Every Sonos zone as a system audio output.
plugins.description: Makes every Sonos zone on your network a selectable system audio output, including legacy Play:1 / Play:3 / Play:5 / Playbar / Connect speakers that have no AirPlay.

plugins.name: Pastey
plugins.tagline: A clipboard that remembers.
plugins.description: A compact, searchable 200-item clipboard history for the Omarchy bar.

plugins.name: Halo Bluetooth
plugins.tagline: A live sonar hero with battery halos.
plugins.description: Bluetooth with a live sonar hero, per-device battery halos and type-aware glyphs.

plugins.name: Chronos
plugins.tagline: A clock and calendar with a pulse.
plugins.description: Clock and calendar with a pulse — a day-progress ring, shimmering year and life rails, a drawn moon phase, and a month grid that arrives on a stagger. A fork of Omarchy's stock clock.

plugins.name: Tesla
plugins.tagline: Your car in the bar.
plugins.description: Your Tesla in the bar: where it is, how full it is, how far that gets you, what you can tell it to do, and every field it reports, all on one screen, with a private tariff notebook

plugins.name: Glide
plugins.tagline: Glide for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Share mouse and keyboard across paired Omarchy machines on your LAN. Arrange displays in the native panel, authorize peers over SSH and cross an edge to switch. Powered by Lan Mouse; clipboard contents stay local.
plugins.credit: Powered by Lan Mouse, by Ferdinand Schober and contributors.

plugins.name: Beam
plugins.tagline: Beam for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Stream your Omarchy desktop to an iPad with Sunshine and Moonlight. A native panel guides setup and shows connection details and readiness.

plugins.name: Omarchy Doctor
plugins.tagline: Check, understand, verify.
plugins.description: Check system, storage, graphics, network, audio and shell health with bounded scans, live diagrams, evidence and seven-day local history. Ask my agent hands a selected finding to your chosen assistant; its report appears beside Doctor’s independent recheck.

plugins.name: Lamplight
plugins.tagline: Lamplight for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Control a fleet of Govee lights over local UDP from an Omarchy bar plugin and CLI. Lights follow the active theme, with palette drift, daylight, weather, music and event modes.

plugins.name: Local Intelligence
plugins.tagline: Local Intelligence for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Monitor Ollama activity and control locally installed models from the Omarchy bar.

plugins.name: Mirror
plugins.tagline: Mirror for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Mirror this screen, or extend your desktop, to a Google TV or Chromecast on the LAN, straight from the Omarchy bar. GPU-encoded HLS, played by the TV's Default Media Receiver.

plugins.name: Wisp
plugins.tagline: Wisp for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Shelved at 0.1.0. An unofficial WhatsApp bar client using wacli and local SQLite. It was never tested against a paired WhatsApp account; in-panel QR pairing is unfinished. Kept here as a public experiment.

plugins.name: Beatbar
plugins.tagline: Beatbar for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: A live, theme-reactive PipeWire frequency garden for the Omarchy bar

plugins.name: Boomux
plugins.tagline: Boomux for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Open a sliding Boomux Workspace, Agent, and Node pane from the Omarchy bar.

plugins.name: Calendar Agenda
plugins.tagline: Calendar Agenda for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: A theme-aware Omarchy bar agenda for private HTTPS iCalendar feeds, with day, week, and month views.

plugins.name: Omarchy Config Sync
plugins.tagline: Omarchy Config Sync for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Seamlessly sync all your Omarchy configurations, shortcuts, themes, and plugins between your machines.

plugins.name: OmiDocker
plugins.tagline: OmiDocker for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Docker containers and compose stacks for Omarchy

plugins.name: Elgato Control
plugins.tagline: Elgato Control for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Unofficial adaptive controls for Elgato Stream Deck, Pedal, Wave microphones, and Key Lights.

plugins.name: Notification Center
plugins.tagline: Notification Center for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Every notification you were sent, kept, and readable again

plugins.name: AirPods
plugins.tagline: AirPods for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: AirPods in the Omarchy bar: per-pod and case battery, listening mode, adaptive noise level, conversation awareness, one-bud ANC and ear detection.

plugins.name: Port Doctor
plugins.tagline: Port Doctor for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: See everything on your home network: every host, its open ports and services, and every live connection this machine is making.

plugins.name: rclone
plugins.tagline: rclone for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: rclone activity, remote status and setup in the Omarchy bar — with a cloud that pings while bytes move, a throughput trace, a storage ring on every remote and a two-column panel that fits the screen.

plugins.name: Speaker Calibrator
plugins.tagline: Speaker Calibrator for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Measure with one or many microphones and generate adaptive, repeat-validated, protected parametric speaker tuning.

plugins.name: Omarchy Theme Manager
plugins.tagline: Omarchy Theme Manager for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Manage Omarchy themes and browse Aether-backed Wallhaven wallpapers from the native picker.

plugins.name: Detailed Weather
plugins.tagline: Detailed Weather for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Detailed weather with an interactive orbital ten-day forecast, remaining-hour outlook, city peek, and Open radar in the default browser.

plugins.name: Weather Radar
plugins.tagline: Weather Radar for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Live weather radar map in the Omarchy bar, with optional storm alerts for your location.

plugins.name: IPTV
plugins.tagline: IPTV for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Single-provider IPTV browser for Omarchy (m3u / Xtream, Live + VOD, XMLTV EPG, favorites, fullscreen TV mode). Themed via shell tokens; playback in external mpv.

plugins.name: OmaSpotify
plugins.tagline: OmaSpotify for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Native Quickshell Spotify player with Omarchy themes, a mini player, shortcuts and lyrics. Playback setup is guided from the panel.

plugins.name: Omastorm
plugins.tagline: Omastorm for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Beta NEXRAD radar viewer for Omarchy, with Rust decoding and a native Quickshell panel.

plugins.name: Omagotchi
plugins.tagline: Omagotchi for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: A 1-bit desktop pet in your bar, in the spirit of the 1997 originals: feed it, scrub it clean, cuddle it, and let it out to roam your screen and climb your windows. It hatches, grows, and evolves with the care you give.

plugins.name: Omalaunch
plugins.tagline: Omalaunch for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Extensible command launcher for Omarchy

plugins.name: Omamail
plugins.tagline: Omamail for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Native multi-account email for Gmail, HEY, JMAP and IMAP. Read, triage and reply, handle invitations and unsubscribe; remote images load only when requested.

plugins.name: Plugin Manager
plugins.tagline: Plugin Manager for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Manage installed Omarchy plugins: enable/disable, update, install from git, and remove third-party plugins

plugins.name: Sandman
plugins.tagline: Sandman for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Set lid-close actions and when your screen rests, locks, sleeps, and hibernates.

plugins.name: Fathom
plugins.tagline: Fathom for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: A depth-based Alt-Tab: every window recedes into the distance by how long ago you last used it. Hold Alt, dive with Tab, release to focus.

plugins.name: Dayflow
plugins.tagline: Dayflow for your Omarchy desktop.
plugins.description: Automatic local screen journal with timeline, standup, agent-session recaps, search and a native Omarchy panel. Summaries use a configured vision model.

plugins.name: Districts
plugins.tagline: Your desktop, with a skyline.
plugins.description: Orbit your real desktop city: workspaces become neighborhoods and app windows become buildings. Inspect session families and the resources each owner is using, and preview safe window organization before anything moves.

plugins.name: Mycelium
plugins.tagline: A living map of the seams between your windows.
plugins.description: Roots grow along the seams where your tiled windows meet, at any gap size including none, and answer focus, layout and attention. Trace maps every workspace and jumps to any window. Standalone and local.

plugins.name: Gliff
plugins.tagline: Another machine's Hyprland desktop, one click from the bar.
plugins.description: Lists the machines gliff already knows plus the online Linux nodes on your tailnet; click one to open its Hyprland desktop in a window. gliff needs only ssh between the two machines: no open ports, no accounts, no relay.

plugins.name: iPhone Connect
plugins.tagline: Your iPhone's calls, notifications and music on the desktop.
plugins.description: Take and make your iPhone's calls with the PC's microphone and speakers, and see its notifications, battery and music. It all runs over the Bluetooth link the phone already has for hands-free calls: no app on the phone, no cloud.

plugins.name: OMyPhone
plugins.tagline: Phone calls from the desktop, phone still in your pocket.
plugins.description: Turns the PC into a Bluetooth hands-free kit for your phone, the way a car does. Make and take calls over the phone's own number, with contacts synced from the phone. No app on the phone, no VoIP account, no cloud.

plugins.name: Sidecar
plugins.tagline: A private desktop companion on your phone.
plugins.description: Puts the useful parts of Omarchy on your phone without exposing a terminal, screen or filesystem. Portal switches workspaces and focuses apps, Morph previews and applies installed themes, and pairing is by scanning a QR code.

plugins.name: Omarchy Phone
plugins.tagline: Android control and iPhone AirPlay mirroring.
plugins.description: Android sessions get mouse and keyboard control through scrcpy. iPhone sessions mirror video and audio through AirPlay, which does not allow remote touch or keyboard input. Built entirely in Ruby.

plugins.name: BlueFerry
plugins.tagline: iMessage and SMS through your iPhone, over Bluetooth.
plugins.description: The native Omarchy panel for BlueFerry. Send and receive iMessage and SMS while paired to your iPhone, with no software on the phone, no proxies and no cloud. The bar popup shows connection health and unread conversations, with a reply field under each.

themes.name: 2 Hackrz
themes.tagline: Midnight blue, muted steel, warm terminal.
themes.description: A midnight-blue Omarchy Quattro theme with muted steel accents and warm terminal colors.

tools.name: LightShow
tools.description: GTK4 keyboard RGB controls for MSI MysticLight laptops and Turtle Beach KB7, with 21 effects, Omarchy theme colors and day/night profiles.

tools.name: Omavoice
tools.description: Voice recorder with live whisper.cpp transcription for Omarchy. GTK4 and PipeWire.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/nixfred/omavoice.git && cd omavoice && makepkg -si

tools.name: Imprint
tools.description: Stamp one Omarchy machine onto another.

tools.name: Clipsync
tools.description: One clipboard across Linux, macOS and iPhone. Copy anywhere, paste on Linux, text and photos.

tools.name: Swish
tools.description: macOS Cmd+Tab for Omarchy. Hold SUPER, tab through glass workspace cards with live preview.
tools.credit: Built on hyprshell, by H3rmt and contributors.

tools.name: claude-on-mac
tools.description: Apple ecosystem tools for Claude Code on macOS, including Messages, Mail, Calendar and Notes, with per-message consent for sending.

tools.name: Footswitch
tools.description: Elgato Stream Deck Pedal integration for Omarchy. Separate press and release events support hold-to-talk dictation, lighting controls and workspace switching.

tools.name: Showoff Omarchy
tools.description: Fullscreen desktop demonstrations with glowing captions, live theme picking and real apps. Press Esc twice to stop.

tools.name: Flea
tools.description: Keyboard-first Omarchy file manager with a Quickshell front end, Rust backend, previews, network locations and an optional bar drop shelf.

tools.name: Strata
tools.description: Keyboard-first Linux file manager with desktop integration, previews, network locations and optional phone access.

tools.name: Atmos
tools.description: Standalone Quickshell preferences for Omarchy. Changes settings through Omarchy commands and Hyprland drop-ins. Alpha.

tools.name: Omacontra
tools.description: Standalone fullscreen five-stage arcade boss rush for Linux and Hyprland. Art, music and screensaver animations are included.

tools.name: Meeting Recorder
tools.description: Record microphone and computer audio as separate tracks, transcribe locally with whisper.cpp and review speakers, chapters and a synchronized player. Includes a recording-status bar widget.

tools.name: Omarchy Overwatch
tools.description: Desktop OSINT dashboard with an interactive globe and a catalog of public investigation sources.

tools.name: Omarchy Music
tools.description: Unofficial community music player and contest archive for Omarchy. A static web app with no account or analytics.

tools.name: Omarchy in the Browser
tools.description: An earlier interactive browser recreation of an Omarchy Hyprland session, with tiling, themes, terminal and a simulated filesystem. See source to run it locally.

tools.name: Autocorrect
tools.description: Work in progress: global autocorrect for Omarchy using an fcitx5 module, with Backspace undo.

tools.name: Firstmate
tools.description: Agent coordination with visible workspaces, isolated worktrees and Omarchy terminal integrations. Public fork of kunchenguid’s Firstmate.

retired.name: CPU Pulse
retired.reason: Merged into Pulse, which shows all four in one widget under a single severity model. The separate plugin still works; Pulse is where the work continues.

retired.name: RAM Pulse
retired.reason: Merged into Pulse, which shows all four in one widget under a single severity model. The separate plugin still works; Pulse is where the work continues.

retired.name: Disk Pulse
retired.reason: Merged into Pulse, which shows all four in one widget under a single severity model. The separate plugin still works; Pulse is where the work continues.

retired.name: Net Pulse
retired.reason: Merged into Pulse, which shows all four in one widget under a single severity model. The separate plugin still works; Pulse is where the work continues.

retired.name: Remarchy
retired.reason: Earlier declarative machine-manifest experiment. See Imprint for the later machine-copy workflow.
